title: ActorSkillListingV2
description: actor.skill-listing@2: a skill in the registry, the record every site shows on its card (ADR-058, ADR-060). It keeps every field and meaning of actor.skill-listing@1 and adds what a sandbox skill needs to be shown and run: the document is actor.skill@2, CODE lists, per code resource, its name (the resource path a tool's entry names), the Media object id its bytes are stored under and the sha256 of those bytes, so the bytes that run are the bytes that were scanned; and the SCAN's findings may name the TOOL they are about, so a person reads the scan one tool at a time. A sandbox listing carries code; a prompt listing carries none. It still carries the PUBLISHER from the registry's own record (vouched: unlike the document's author, this is who published it), the SCAN (its state and findings travel with the listing), and the CURATOR's state. Install rules every site keeps: a passed skill installs in one tap; a flagged one only after the person reads the findings and confirms; a failed one never; a stale or archived one is not offered. Installing copies the document into the person's agent; it grants nothing (the skill's requires is a declaration).

code.description: Per code resource of a sandbox skill: the resource path a tool entry names, the Media object the registry stored its bytes under, and the sha256 of those bytes. Required when the skill runs in a sandbox; absent for a prompt skill.

name.description: The resource path, as the document's tools entry names it.

media_id.description: The Media object id the code bytes are stored under.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the code bytes.

publisher.description: Who published it, from the registry's own record.

kind.description: OpenVibe's own skills, or a person's.

subject.description: The person who published it (kind person).

scan.description: What the registry's scan found. It travels with the listing, and a finding about a tool names it.

rule.description: Which rule, such as code.network or code.env.

where.description: instructions, description, or a resource path.

tool.description: The tool the finding is about, when it is about one tool.

note.description: What it found, in plain words.

curator.description: The curator ships with the catalogue: what is used stays, what is not goes stale.

near_duplicate_of.description: A listing that does the same job.
